text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The electrifying sprint across 1,200
meters of turf
goes by in a flash. Before I know what's
happening, the view ahead
grows crowded.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
They all rush past the finish line in what
seems like
an instant. Compared to
them, my speed...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My form... is embarrassingly poor.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Keep your head up.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...King?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We're still on the turf. That means we
still have a
responsibility to run with all
our might.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If you truly wish to learn from me, then
steel
yourself and watch me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on me until the very
end.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
King Halo?! You realize this is the
winner's circle,
right?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I know full well. Normally, I wouldn't
have any
right to stand here after
today's result.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
However, there's something I need to
say.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
You lost, King Halo! What are you trying
to
prove?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Her running today lacked its usual
brilliance.
Maybe she's past her prime...

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Forcing herself into the winner's circle?
What a sore loser. Quit fiending for the
spotlight and
step aside for the newer
generation.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Listen well!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm granting you all the right to hear me
speak.
Racing is a world of victory and
defeat.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Results are everything. That means
today I am a
loser who had her dream of
victory shattered.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
However, I am proud that I chose to
enter this
race, and I do not feel I was
selfish in the
slightest!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You may try, but you'll never make me
feel
ashamed!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because deciding to take on today's
challenge
was the choice that best
represents me as a
person!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I take pride in making choices that
represent who I am! No matter what
anyone else may say, this is
the path I
tread!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's all I have to say. So please go
ahead and
celebrate the Umamusume
who won today.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: King Halo's so cool...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, no one can be like her. She's
like... a real
living king.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Kawakami?
...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I thought you wouldn't want to see that.
Didn't I
look pitiful?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I've disgraced your expectations... You
probably
feel hurt.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, of course not! There's no way I'd feel
that
way!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I see...
I'm not sure if that's lip service or
not, but
it won't change what I say, nor
how I'll act.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If the day ever comes when we compete
again, I'll
go all out and give you a good
thrashing.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I won't hold back against any opponent, no
matter how uncouth it may seem.
That's how I
show respect to those who
challenge me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Right. I'm looking forward to racing
you again!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. The answer was within me
all
along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some days later, Kawakami Princess
comes to me
with a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Before the Takamatsunomiya Kinen,
King asked
me whether I felt pride in
myself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whether I could take pride in my own
actions.
Whether they reflect my true
self.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King's words made me realize
something—staying true to myself
doesn't mean I'm being
self-centered. So
I'll keep on moving forward...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone else might think
of me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, for next month's Fan Fest, I
want to take
part in this event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess shows me a plan for a
stage
event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Last Year's Tiara Tour in Retrospect!" A
talk
show presented by glamorous
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It seems the Umamusume I competed
against last
year will be there, as well as
all their fans.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess wouldn't back down from
an
opportunity like this just because she
felt
intimidated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see sincere determination burning in
her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But somewhere deeper, I sense a subtle
tremor, a
trembling accompanied by an
eagerness to grow.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Right.
